# Astryx neutral theme (vendored)

`theme-neutral.css` is the unmodified `dist/theme.css` of
[`@astryxdesign/theme-neutral`](https://github.com/meta/astryx) **0.7.16**
(MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Meta Platforms, Inc.; see `LICENSE`).

It only defines CSS custom properties (colour, type scale, spacing, radius,
shadow, motion) scoped to `[data-astryx-theme="neutral"]`. The npm package is not
installed because it pulls React and an icon library into the Angular build.
The package's `fonts.css` is deliberately not used: it loads Google Fonts at
runtime, which conflicts with offline operation; the theme falls back to the
system UI font stack.

NormaCase-specific overrides (medical-blue accent, status colours) live in
`src/styles.css` and do not edit this file. To update, replace the file with the
new `dist/theme.css`, adjust the version above and re-run the visual checks.
